planets.name: TOI-1448 b
planets.description: Transiting planet of TOI-1448 with a 8.11-day year, found in 2024.

text.card: TOI-1448 b was found in 2024 by TESS as it crossed its star.
text.introduction: It is the only planet known around TOI-1448. Its orbit and size follow Hori et al. 2024's fit, the archive's default.
